entities.summary: Cho I-hsuan is a Taiwanese professional tennis player. On 9 June 2025, she peaked at world No. 160 in the WTA doubles rankings. She has won 18 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit. On 23 October 2023, she reached her best singles ranking of No. 573. Her younger sister, Cho Yi-tsen is also a professional player.
